description_long:
The Associated Press promise-tracker data retrieved on October 2, 2026, declares a last-modified timestamp of December 3, 2025. It contains 25 selected campaign pledges, with five marked “Kept,” nine “In progress” and eleven “It’s complicated.” The kept entries concern January 6 clemency, release of Kennedy-assassination records, declaration of a national energy emergency, withdrawal from the Paris Agreement and making expiring tax cuts permanent.

Other entries remained in different categories. The promise to eliminate the Education Department and the pledge to conduct the largest deportation program were listed as in progress. Ending birthright citizenship, halving energy prices, making in vitro fertilization free and ending the Russia-Ukraine war were among the complicated entries. Each row provides the promise, a policy category and links to reporting or government actions; some also identify the proposed implementation method. The data allows readers to inspect these individual ratings and their cited evidence. It does not provide a performance threshold that would establish that Trump was generally “behind,” and this retrieval is not a verified February or March 2026 archive.
